scope: six source-claimed EDD records in public NumCosmo test fixture; not a full EDD export

schema.name: pgc
schema.description: The Catalogue of Principal Galaxies (PGC) Number

schema.name: SNIa
schema.description: SNIa name; multiple SN ID separated by /

schema.name: IDT17g
schema.description: Group ID in Tempel 2017 SDSS group catalog

schema.name: 1PGC
schema.description: PGC identification of brightest member of group

schema.name: Vcmb
schema.description: Radial velocity (cz) with respect to the CMB radiation

schema.name: Vmod
schema.description: Velocity in CMB frame; cosmological adjustment described in CF2 data paper

schema.name: DM_zp
schema.description: Weighted average distance modulus shifted to absolute scale set by calibrators

schema.name: DM_av
schema.description: Weighted average distance moduli (w=1/sigma^2) [excluding Walker+15]

schema.name: eDM
schema.description: Minimum error of all measured moduli

schema.name: DM_pantheonplus
schema.description: SNIa distance moduli in Scolnic Pantheonplus20

schema.name: eDM_pantheonplus
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Pantheonplus20 distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_scolnic
schema.description: distance moduli in Scolnic SNIa 3 Tables on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_scolnic
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Scolnic 3 Tables distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_csp1
schema.description: distance moduli in CSP1 Burns18 (Burns+2018,ApJ,869:56) on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_csp1
schema.description: rms dispersion of the CSP1 Burns18 distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_ganesh
schema.description: distance moduli in LOSS Ganeshalingam13 (Ganeshalingam+2013,MNRAS,433,2240) on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_ganesh
schema.description: rms dispersion of the LOSS Ganeshalingam13 distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_rest
schema.description: Rest+ (2014,ApJ,795:44) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_rest
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Rest+ distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_amanullah
schema.description: Union2 (Amanullah et. 2010,ApJ,716,712) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_amanullah
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Union2 distance measures (adding 0.15 mag in quadrature)

schema.name: DM_jha
schema.description: Jha et al. (2007,ApJ,659,122) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_jha
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Jha

schema.name: DM_prieto
schema.description: Prieto et al. (2006,ApJ,647,501) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_prieto
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Prieto

schema.name: DM_hicken
schema.description: Hicken et al. (2009,ApJ,700,109) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_hicken
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Hicken

schema.name: DM_folatelli
schema.description: Folatelli et al. (2010,AJ,139,120) distance moduli in All CF3 SNIa on the Pantheonplus20 scales

schema.name: eDM_folatelli
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Folatelli

schema.name: DM_walker
schema.description: Walker et al. (2015,ApJS,219:13) distance moduli on CF2 scale

schema.name: eDM_walker
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Walker

schema.name: DM_stahl
schema.description: Stahl et al. (2021,MNRAS,505,2300) distance moduli on Stahl

schema.name: eDM_stahl
schema.description: rms dispersion of the Stahl

schema.name: DM_sh0es
schema.description: Pantheon+SH0ES (2021,arXiv:2112.04510) distance moduli on SH0ES scale

schema.name: eDM_sh0es
schema.description: Error estimates for Pantheonplus+SH0ES measures of corrected peak B magnitude

schema.name: DM_twins
schema.description: Boone et al. (2021,ApJ, 912, 21) distance moduli on scale assuming H0=75

schema.name: eDM_twins
schema.description: Mean rms dispersion of twin sample distance measures

schema.name: DM_avelino
schema.description: Avelino et al. (2019,ApJ, 887, 106); best of YJHK template or YJHK IRmax distance moduli on scale assuming H0=73.24

schema.name: eDM_avelino
schema.description: Approximated rms dispersion of Avelino distance measures

schema.name: RA
schema.description: Right Ascension of host, J2000

schema.name: DE
schema.description: Declination of host, J2000

schema.name: glon
schema.description: Galactic longitude of host

schema.name: glat
schema.description: Galactic latitude of host

schema.name: sgl
schema.description: Supergalactic longitude of host

schema.name: sgb
schema.description: Supergalactic latitude of host

caveats: Source fixture labels itself as the first six rows of an EDD export; live EDD was not queried.
No entire-catalogue contributor completeness, row independence, selection law or covariance inferred.
No upstream Python, notebook or serialized .gvar object executed or loaded.
